title: Lot of storage
text: Lot of storage. We split these up into two rooms and it holds a lot of storage. They seem sturdy and zip easily. The clear top is nice to me about you see what’s in it without opening it up.

product_metadata.title: Budding Joy 4 Pack Under bed Storage Containers Organizer Large Capacity Underbed Clothes Storage Bins Organization and Storage Bedroom Foldable Storage Bags with Clear Window Black
features: [Multipurpose Underbed Storage Bags] - This set of 6 underbed storage containers fits under your bed, under your sofa, and in your closet. Very good for storing quilts, blankets, clothes, pillows, sweaters, towels, toys and other items.

[High Quality, Safe and Breathable Material]- The underbed storage container is made of 100% new three-layer composite non-woven fabric and high quality PVC, breathable, light weight, strong enough and durable, with smooth internal air circulation.

[User-friendly Design]- This underbed storage bags have two sturdy handles on the front and side for easy removal. Bimetal zipper design, strong and durable. Top transparent window, can easily find the desired items.

[Large Capacity Storage, Foldable]- The size of the underbed storage bags is: 100cm x 50cm x 18cm / 39 "x 20" x 7 ", super capacity, you can store anything, and very easy to use when moving. When not in use, the storage bag can be folded and stored to save space.
